name: Economy-wide, gross
description: Compensation of employees / gross domestic income. The broadest, whole-economy measure; the denominator includes depreciation, production taxes and corporate income taxes. This is the "50-50 split" framing the Tax Foundation post criticizes.

name: Economy-wide, net of depreciation
description: Compensation of employees / (GDI - depreciation). Removes only consumption of fixed capital, leaving production and corporate taxes in the denominator; the standard "net national income" convention in Rognlie (2015) and Bridgman (2018).

name: Economy-wide, net, proprietors' income excluded
description: Compensation / net income, where net income excludes depreciation, production taxes and corporate income taxes, and proprietors' income is treated as neither labor nor capital. This is the Tax Foundation's own headline convention.

name: Economy-wide, net, all proprietors' income to labor
description: Same net-income denominator as the Tax Foundation convention, but all of proprietors' income is added to the numerator  -  the upper bound flagged by Gollin (2002).

name: Economy-wide, net, 75% of proprietors' income to labor
description: Same net-income denominator, with 75% of proprietors' income added to the numerator, following Smith, Yagan, Zidar and Zwick (2019), who attribute roughly three-quarters of pass-through profit to human capital.

name: BLS official measure (nonfarm business)
description: BLS's own "Labor Share" series for the nonfarm business sector (PRS85006173): labor compensation / current-dollar output, indexed to 2017=100. Adds an imputed wage equivalent for roughly half of proprietors' income; excludes government, nonprofits and owner-occupied housing.

name: Corporate business (all corporations), gross
description: Compensation / gross value added of corporate business (NIPA Table 1.14). Includes all corporations, financial and nonfinancial.

name: Corporate business (all corporations), net
description: Compensation / net value added of corporate business (gross value added less depreciation).

name: Corporate business (all corporations), net of production taxes
description: Compensation / (compensation + net operating surplus), i.e. net value added with production taxes also removed from the denominator.

name: Nonfinancial corporate business, gross
description: Compensation / gross value added of nonfinancial corporate business  -  excludes the financial sector and all proprietors' income and imputed rent.

name: Nonfinancial corporate business, net
description: Compensation / net value added of nonfinancial corporate business.

name: Nonfinancial corporate business, net of production taxes
description: Compensation / (compensation + net operating surplus), nonfinancial corporate business. This is the exact construction behind the deck's slide 5 and slide 16 charts.

name: Corporate profits (pretax) as a share of GDI
description: Corporate profits with IVA & CCAdj, all corporations / gross domestic income  -  the whole-economy "profits as a share of GDP" framing common in press coverage.

name: Corporate profit margin, pretax, gross
description: Corporate profits with IVA & CCAdj / gross value added, all corporations.

name: Corporate profit margin, pretax, net
description: Corporate profits with IVA & CCAdj / net value added, all corporations.

name: Corporate profit margin, after tax, gross
description: Corporate profits after tax with IVA & CCAdj / gross value added, all corporations.

name: Corporate profit margin, after tax, net
description: Corporate profits after tax with IVA & CCAdj / net value added, all corporations.

name: Nonfinancial corporate profit margin, pretax, gross
description: Corporate profits with IVA & CCAdj / gross value added, nonfinancial corporate business only. This is the exact construction behind the deck's slide 2 chart ("Corporate Profits Remain Elevated").

name: Nonfinancial corporate profit margin, pretax, net
description: Corporate profits with IVA & CCAdj / net value added, nonfinancial corporate business.

name: Nonfinancial corporate profit margin, after tax, gross
description: Corporate profits after tax with IVA & CCAdj / gross value added, nonfinancial corporate business.

name: Nonfinancial net operating surplus, net
description: Net operating surplus (profits + net interest + business transfer payments  -  the broadest NIPA capital-income aggregate) / net value added, nonfinancial corporate business.
